Project Overview

A 3-4 year funded PhD (CDT) focusing on 2D materials, advanced materials, energy, and electronics.

How to Apply

Via Postgraduate Course Directory entry for "2D Materials of Tomorrow EPSRC CDT PhD". Apply to the programme, then choose/develop a project with supervisors.
